basic_profile.bio: A passionate digital pet enthusiast hailing from Portland, Oregon. I love collecting and caring for virtual pets, especially Tamagotchis. When I'm not busy with my digital pets, I work as a software developer focusing on game development. I have a deep interest in modding games to enhance user experiences. My evenings are usually spent online, where I engage with various communities. I’m in a long-term relationship, and we both enjoy gaming and exploring local breweries on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science, I have honed my skills in software development, particularly in the gaming industry. My love for games and digital pets has fueled my interest in learning game modding, which I mostly taught myself through online resources and community forums. I actively share my knowledge and provide tips to both novice and experienced modders.
